Hi Santana —

Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer role and for the quick follow. I lead sourcing for the team; would love to do a short 20-minute phone screen to learn a bit about your systems experience and surface any questions you have about Redwood.

Are you available for a 20-minute call on any of these evening windows (your local time) this week?
- Tue 14 Dec, 19:00–20:30 CET (10:00–11:30 PST)
- Wed 15 Dec, 20:00–21:00 CET (11:00–12:00 PST)
- Thu 16 Dec, 18:30–20:00 CET (09:30–11:00 PST)

If none of those work, send me 2–3 other 20-minute windows that fit your weekday evenings and I’ll do the timezone math. We typically do a video call but can do phone first — whichever you prefer.

Irene (cc’d) will likely sit in for the second half of the call if schedules align; otherwise this will be a first touch with me.

Best,
Elliot Price
Talent Acquisition (Contractors + Platforms)
Redwood Inference
